series.name: H3/AC3 (three-phase hybrid) - grid and phase-synchronising faults
series.notes: H3/AC3 models verified in the manual's own model list: H3-5.0-E, H3-6.0-E, H3-8.0-E, H3-9.9-E, H3-10.0-E, H3-12.0-E. Four of these five grid rows are byte-identical to H1 G2 and KH/KA - they are still kept in a SEPARATE series because PLL_ OverTime exists only on the three-phase line and because a three-phase Pakistani install must be told to check all three phases, not one. Never merge into foxess-h1-ac1-g2-grid even though 'Grid Volt Fault' is the same string.

meaning.en: The H3 has lost the grid reference on all three phases and isolated itself. On a three-phase unit this can be a single-phase dropout, not a total outage.
meaning.ur: H3 ne teenon phases par se grid reference kho diya aur khud ko alag kar liya. Three-phase unit par yeh ek phase ka dropout bhi ho sakta hai, poora outage nahi.

causes.en: Only one phase lost - a tripped 3-pole/4-pole MCB with one pole failed, or one phase conductor open in the board or at the inverter.
causes.ur: Sirf ek phase gaya - 3-pole/4-pole MCB ka aik pole kharab, ya board ya inverter par aik phase conductor khari hui.

causes.en: Total utility outage, or a loose/burnt AC terminal at the inverter or consumer unit.
causes.ur: Poora utility outage, ya inverter ya consumer unit par AC terminal loose ya burnt.

causes.en: Neutral missing or loose on a three-phase 4-wire supply, which can make the inverter lose its reference.
causes.ur: Teenon phase wale 4-wire supply par neutral missing ya loose, jis se inverter ka reference chala jata hai.

solutions.en: Check all three poles of the PV/solar board MCB individually, not just the main lever, and reset any that have tripped.
solutions.ur: PV/solar board ke MCB ke teenon poles ko alag alag check karein, sirf main lever nahi, aur jo trip hua ho reset karein.

solutions.en: With power isolated, continuity-test each phase and the neutral from the consumer unit to the inverter's GRID port; find and re-land the open one.
solutions.ur: Power isolate kar ke, consumer unit se inverter ke GRID port tak har phase aur neutral ki continuity test karein; khari hui wali dhundh kar dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Watch FoxCloud for how long the fault lasts; a sub-second dropout that repeats is a loose connection, not an outage.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein dekhein ke fault kitni der raha; aik second se bhi kam ka dobara dohra hona loose connection hai, outage nahi.

notes.en: FoxESS requires a bi-directional RCD on grid-tied ports; for a three-phase H1/H3 install that is typically a 4-pole device. Confirm the device rating against the H3 manual before swapping anything.
notes.ur: FoxESS grid-tied ports par bi-directional RCD maangta hai; teenon phase wale H1/H3 install par yeh aam tor par 4-pole hota hai. Kuch bhi badalne se pehle H3 manual ke mutabiq device ki rating confirm karein.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

meaning.en: Measured grid voltage is outside the inverter's permitted window, so the H3 refuses to connect. On a three-phase unit this is checked and reported per phase.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage inverter ki ijazat window se bahar hai, is liye H3 connect nahi ho raha. Three-phase unit par yeh har phase ke liye alag check aur report hota hai.

causes.en: High export-time grid voltage, typical of a long line or a substation transformer tap set too high.
causes.ur: Export ke waqt grid voltage high - lambi line ya substation transformer ka tap zyada par hona aam wajah hai.

causes.en: One phase sagging under an unbalanced load while the other two sit normal - very common on Pakistani three-phase feeders with uneven phase loading.
causes.ur: Unbalanced load ke under aik phase gir raha hai jabke baaki do normal hain - Pakistan ke three-phase feeders par uneven phase loading ke saath yeh bohat aam hai.

causes.en: Severe dip from a large motor or generator starting on the same feeder.
causes.ur: Wahi feeder par kisi bade motor ya generator ke chalne se grid voltage gir gaya.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid to settle; the unit reconnects on its own once voltage is back in range, as FoxESS states.
solutions.ur: Grid settle hone dein; jaise FoxESS kahe voltage range mein aate hi unit khud reconnect ho jayega.

solutions.en: Clamp a multimeter on EACH phase in turn at the inverter's AC terminal and record all three readings - do not judge on one phase.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminal par ek-ek phase par clamp multimeter lagayein aur teenon readings note karein - aik phase par faisla na karein.

solutions.en: If one phase is persistently lower, redistribute the load across phases at the board, starting with the heaviest single-phase loads.
solutions.ur: Agar aik phase baar baar kam rehti hai to board par load ko phases mein baant lein, sab se bhaari single-phase loads se shuru karein.

notes.en: Pakistan's nominal three-phase supply is 415/230 V at 50 Hz. A persistent single-phase sag is usually a distribution problem, not an inverter problem - escalate to the DISCO feeder office with the three recorded readings.
notes.ur: Pakistan ki nominal three-phase supply 415/230 V 50 Hz hai. Aik phase ka mustaqal girna aam tor par distribution ka masla hai, inverter ka nahi - teenon recorded readings ke saath DISCO feeder office ko batayein.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

meaning.en: Grid frequency is outside the permitted band, so the H3 has disconnected from the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency ijazat range se bahar hai, is liye H3 grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Utility frequency excursion, common during feeder load shedding or generator handover.
causes.ur: Utility frequency excursion - feeder load shedding ya generator handover ke waqt aam hai.

causes.en: Inverter running in parallel with a generator that is governing frequency poorly.
causes.ur: Inverter aise generator ke saath parallel chal raha hai jo frequency theek se control nahi kar raha.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid to return to nominal; the unit will reconnect automatically.
solutions.ur: Grid nominal par aane ka intezar karein; unit khud reconnect ho jayega.

solutions.en: Read live frequency in FoxCloud and note whether the excursions coincide with generator running hours.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein live frequency padhein aur note karein ke excursion generator chalne ke waqt hote hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: If a generator is involved, adjust its governor and set the inverter's grid-tie limits per the generator's own voltage/frequency window.
solutions.ur: Agar generator involved hai to uska governor adjust karein aur inverter ke grid-tie limits generator ke voltage/frequency window ke mutabiq set karein.

notes.en: Same remedy text as H1 and KH/KA, but keep it on the H3 series: a three-phase technician must also confirm all three phase conductors are present before blaming frequency.
notes.ur: H1 aur KH/KA jaisa hi remedy text, lekin H3 series par hi rakhein: three-phase wale technician ko frequency par blame karne se pehle teenon phase conductors ki maujoodgi bhi confirm karni hogi.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

title.en: Three-phase unit fed from a single-phase AC
title.ur: Teenon phase wala unit aik phase AC se chal raha hai

meaning.en: The phase-locked loop could not lock onto a balanced three-phase reference within its time limit, which in practice means the inverter is being fed or is seeing only a single phase.
meaning.ur: Phase-locked loop apni time limit mein balanced teenon-phase reference par lock nahi kar paya, jis ka amli matlab hai ke inverter ko sirf aik phase di ja rahi hai ya woh sirf aik phase dekh raha hai.

causes.en: Installer error: a three-phase H3 wired to a single-phase supply, or only one of three phases landed at the GRID port.
causes.ur: Installer ki galti: teenon-phase H3 ko single-phase supply se jora gaya, ya GRID port par teenon mein se sirf aik phase laga.

causes.en: Two of the three phase conductors open between the consumer unit and the inverter, leaving one phase alive.
causes.ur: Consumer unit aur inverter ke darmiyan teenon phase conductors mein se do khari hui, sirf aik phase zinda.

causes.en: Severe phase unbalance or a missing neutral on a 4-wire supply so the PLL reference is not a clean sinusoid.
causes.ur: 4-wire supply par bhaari phase unbalance ya missing neutral, jis se PLL reference saaf sinusoidal nahi banta.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then confirm with a meter that all three phases AND the neutral are present at the inverter's GRID port.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir multimeter se confirm karein ke inverter ke GRID port par teenon phases aur neutral mojood hain.

solutions.en: If the site genuinely has single-phase supply, this model is the wrong unit - do not attempt to make it run; the correct part is a single-phase hybrid.
solutions.ur: Agar site par waqai single-phase supply hai to yeh model ghalat unit hai - isay chalane ki koshish na karein; theek part single-phase hybrid hai.

solutions.en: Once all phases are restored, let the unit reconnect on its own as FoxESS directs before touching any settings.
solutions.ur: Jab teenon phases wapas aa jayen, jaise FoxESS kahe settings chhune se pehle unit ko khud reconnect hone dein.

notes.en: H3-ONLY code - the string PLL_ OverTime does not appear in the H1, KH/KA or T tables. The trailing underscore in 'PLL_ OverTime' is as printed; make the lookup tolerant of PLL OverTime and PLL_OverTime.
notes.ur: Yeh sirf H3 ka code hai - 'PLL_ OverTime' string H1, KH/KA ya T ki table mein nahi hai. 'PLL_ OverTime' mein aakhir ki underscore jaisa chhapa gaya hai; lookup ko PLL OverTime aur PLL_OverTime dono ke liye tolerant rakhein.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

title.en: 10-minute average grid voltage out of range
title.ur: 10 minute ka average grid voltage range se bahar

meaning.en: The rolling 10-minute average of grid voltage has been out of range. A sustained-condition protection, not a spike detector.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage ka chalta hua 10 minute ka average range se bahar chala gaya hai. Yeh mustaqil-condition protection hai, spike detector nahi.

causes.en: Sustained grid over-voltage, often with high PV export into an already-high feeder.
causes.ur: Grid ka mustaqil over-voltage - aksar already high feeder mein zyada PV export ke saath.

causes.en: Substation transformer tap set high and left uncorrected.
causes.ur: Substation transformer ka tap high set hai aur theek nahi kiya gaya.

causes.en: One phase dragging the average while the other two are high during unbalanced export.
causes.ur: Unbalanced export ke dauraan aik phase average ko neeche kheench rahi hai jabke baaki do high hain.

solutions.en: Check the 10-minute average voltage in FoxCloud and record the peak before touching anything.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein 10 minute ka average voltage dekhein aur kuch bhi chhune se pehle peak note karein.

solutions.en: Measure each phase's 10-minute average separately, because one bad phase can trip a protection that looks like a whole-inverter problem.
solutions.ur: Har phase ka 10 minute ka average alag alag napen, kyunke aik kharab phase wohi protection chala sakta hai jo poore inverter ka masla lagta hai.

solutions.en: Ask the DISCO feeder office to log grid voltage and correct the substation transformer tap - the durable fix.
solutions.ur: DISCO feeder office se grid voltage log karwa kar substation transformer tap theek karwayein - yehi permanent hal hai.

notes.en: The H3 manual's row for this code gives the same bare 'system will reconnect' remedy as H1 - it does NOT document any front-panel menu path for the limit. Do not quote an unverified settings path for this model.
notes.ur: H3 manual mein is code ki row H1 jaisa hi khulasa 'system will reconnect' hal deti hai - is limit ka koi front-panel menu path ismein likha nahi hai. Is model ke liye unverified settings path na batayein.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List
